description: No credential or login required. List the certificate templates that can be applied for (9). The slugs returned here are exactly the values accepted by cert_template; nothing else is. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
